poison.name: 中毒
poison.desc: 每回合損失 5% 最大 HP
poison.desc_en: Lose 5% of max HP each turn

burn.name: 燃燒
burn.desc: 每回合受到灼燒傷害，隨持續時間遞增（4%→8%→12%→16%→20% 最大HP）
burn.desc_en: Takes scorching damage each turn, increasing the longer it lasts (4%→8%→12%→16%→20% max HP)

freeze.name: 冰凍
freeze.desc: 身體被寒氣凍結，速度大幅下降（行動變慢），持續數回合
freeze.desc_en: Your body is frozen by intense cold, greatly reducing speed (acting less often) for several turns

paralysis.name: 麻痺
paralysis.desc: 有機率無法行動，且攻擊/魔攻永久下降
paralysis.desc_en: Chance to be unable to act, with a permanent reduction to Attack/Magic Attack

sleep.name: 睡眠
sleep.desc: 100% 無法行動，但只要受到傷害就會立刻清醒
sleep.desc_en: Completely unable to act, but wakes up immediately upon taking damage

berserk.name: 狂暴
berserk.desc: 陷入瘋狂，只能使用普通攻擊，但攻擊力大幅提升
berserk.desc_en: Driven into a frenzy, can only use basic attacks, but Attack is greatly increased

corrosion.name: 腐蝕
corrosion.desc: 地下城專屬：每層每回合造成固定傷害，會持續累積（有層數上限）
corrosion.desc_en: Dungeon-only: each stack deals flat damage every turn and keeps accumulating (up to a stack cap)

silence.name: 沉默
silence.desc: 無法施放任何技能（普通攻擊、防禦與道具不受影響）
silence.desc_en: Cannot cast any skills (basic attacks, defending, and items are unaffected)

intangible.name: 無實體
intangible.desc: 化為虛影，期間受到的任何一次傷害至多只有 1 點
intangible.desc_en: Fades into a phantom — every instance of damage taken is reduced to at most 1

blood_mark.name: 血印
blood_mark.desc_en: Can be consumed by Warlock skills.
